defects.description: Truncation after normalization can leave trailing whitespace in the interpreted query.
defects.why_missed: S9(d): a naive oracle takes the normalized prefix of the requested length, which looks right but violates the final whitespace postcondition; existing examples are short or truncate inside a word.

defects.description: The deployment allowlist omits SEARCH_MATCH_MODE although settings reads and documents it.

trigger.input: timeout 20 node --input-type=module -e 'import {renderEnvironment} from "./deploy/environment.mjs"; import {readSettings} from "./src/settings.js"; const input={SEARCH_MATCH_MODE:"phrase"}; const direct=readSettings(input); const deployed=readSettings(renderEnvironment(input)); console.log(JSON.stringify({direct:direct.matchMode,deployed:deployed.matchMode}));'

defects.why_missed: S9(d): direct settings reads suggest the requested mode is supported, but deployment must preserve that value too; matching-mode tests bypass the renderer and renderer tests use older settings only.
